The '''Hawk's Nest''' was the codename of a military outpost established by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Old Paths]] of [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Commander by Colonel [[Deulo]], it was eventually discovered by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces, who launched an assault on it from [[Fort Kodentha]]. The assault was defeated, but [[General/Legends|General]] [[Thelonia Redrish]] ordered Hawk's Nest and all its evidence destroyed before more reinforcements could arrive. As the commandos were setting charges, they were ambushed by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] before they were ready for detonation and were all killed in the resulting firefight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hawk's Nest appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
